notes.title: Crisis of the Middle Ages Version 1.0.9 now available!
notes.content:
New in Crisis of the Middle Ages Version 1.0.9:
- Added options to configure battle and message speed
- Updated map transitions to be more user friendly
- Fixed two bugs where player could become stuck by being separated from boat
- Updated several battle cut-scenes to be more funny
- Updated Advanced control icons
- Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Crisis of the Middle Ages Version 1.0.8 Now Available
notes.content:
New in Crisis of the Middle Ages Version 1.0.8:
- Added Exit Game button
- Added performance improvements for some older android devices
- Added new green item
- Added new battle cut-scenes for Emia School of Evil
- Added Advanced option to view frame rates
- Typo fixes
- Added more elemental resistance attachable items
- Modified longer battle cut-scenes to only appear once
